subject: Workplace Skills
title: Introverts Can Network Too
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Introverts Can Network Too.

hook.text: Susan Cain, author of 'Quiet,' built one of the largest professional networks in publishing — as a deep introvert.

buildup.text: Networking doesn't mean working a room with a drink in hand. It means building meaningful one-on-one connections.

discovery.text: Introverts excel at deep listening, thoughtful follow-ups, and one-on-one conversations — all networking gold.

twist.text: Extroverts collect contacts. Introverts build relationships. Quality beats quantity every time in networking.

climax.text: Skip the big events. Focus on small dinners, coffee chats, and thoughtful messages. Play to your strengths.

punchline.text: Deep connections beat wide ones. Introverts win here.

quiz.question: Why are introverts often effective networkers?
options: They attend more networking events than extroverts
They excel at deep listening and meaningful one-on-one connections
They use social media more effectively
